reason: Page 5 of this MS (rotated landscape) has a garbled text layer (split glyph runs such as '970 01/22', 'Ca ambridge Interna ational', 'Qu uestion Answer Mar rks', '© U CLES 2018', and keys split as '2' + '2(b)(i)'), so the printed keys 2(b)(i) (p5 y216.4), 2(b)(ii) (y293.5) and 2(c)(i) (y499.4) were not read, and the page-5 running header (y21-47), the 'Question Answer Marks' column-header row (y56-68) and the copyright footer (y550-559) were not recognised as furniture. The three keys are placed by hand at their printed lines (labels end before x=101, answer content starts at x=117); the page-5 header, column-header row and footer are whited out by position, and because the garbled word boxes do not match the drawn glyphs, all four printed labels in the page-5 Question column (x62-112) are whited out by hand. Because the page-5 header is not recognised, the automatic cut of 1(d)(ii) (last key on page 4) also took the page-5 band above the first table row (y47.5-73.2, only the whited-out column-header row); 1(d)(ii) is therefore cut by hand to its page-4 rows (y322.7-370.8), which hold all its printed marking points.
